name: destiny-knot
effect: Held: When the holder becomes Attracted, the Pokémon it is Attracted to becomes Attracted back.
shortEffect: Held: Infatuates opposing Pokémon when holder is inflicted with infatuation.

flavorTextEntries.text: A long, thin, bright red string to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder becomes infatuated, the foe does too.
